Bombay HC Clerk Exam Protested Over Alleged Glitches, Retest Demanded

Candidates protesting alleged glitches and server issues in the Bombay High Court clerk recruitment exam joined forces with CJP convenor Abhijeet Dipke. They are demanding a retest, claiming technical malfunctions unfairly led to many students being declared unsuccessful. The protests and demands for retests come amid a broader concern in India about exam paper leaks and technical errors in recruitment processes.
